name: Neural Network Volume Classification
aliases: Painting-Based Intelligent User Interface for Volume Classification
definition: A method for classifying volume data using an artificial neural network trained on user-painted samples to map voxel properties to an uncertainty value, which is then mapped to opacity for hardware-accelerated rendering.
summary: Neural Network Volume Classification is an interactive method that partitions volumetric data into material classes by training a neural network on user-painted samples, distinguishing itself by focusing on explicit material classification rather than implicit scene reconstruction.
